## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.98% | 1M: +0.41%) and QQQ BELOW TREND (1W: -1.73% | 1M: -4.42%) show equity dispersion while XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +9.51%) and broad commodity strength confirm mixed cyclical support.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Commodity-led cyclical lift: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +16.85%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +19.25%) ↑ rising. Credit and rates neutral-to-tightening: HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -0.06%) and TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.95% | 1M: -2.72%) → flat to slightly tighter; VXX RECOVERY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -4.31%) ↑ rising flags short-term fear.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Financial conditions read as neutral: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.95% | 1M: -2.72%) implies higher real yields while Dollar per dataset is neutral (1W: 0.00% | 1M: 0.00%) NEUTRAL.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +9.51%). Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -6.18%) and QQQ BELOW TREND (1W: -1.73% | 1M: -4.42%); Financials in CORRECTION: XLF CORRECTION (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +4.38%). Style: Cyclicals/value showing relative strength versus growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US mixed: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.98% | 1M: +0.41%). EM diverging: EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.88% | 1M: -8.73%) while China FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.44% | 1M: +2.99%) shows idiosyncratic strength.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Risk appetite uneven: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.44% | 1M: +2.30%) and pockets of BTC demand contrast with ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -4.48% | 1M: -3.06%) and IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -1.47%) showing constrained small-cap/speculative flows.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Broad commodity rally: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +16.85%), BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +19.25%) and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +1.13%) ↑ rising, supporting cyclicals; GLD RECOVERY (1W: +1.82% | 1M: -1.42%) shows safe-haven buying.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy clearly strong: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +9.51%) ↑ rising; natural gas mixed with UNG in RECOVERY (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -9.94%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Energy leadership (XLE ABOVE TREND) and broad commodity ETFs showing ABOVE TREND readings. Divergences: multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches across XLF, XBI, IGV and other sector ETFs indicate rotation and short-term noise rather than a clear regime shift (MINOR divergence).

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and commodity exposures (XLE, USO, BNO) showing strength and monitor IBIT for risk appetite; reduce exposure to lagging large-cap tech (XLK, QQQ) and high-beta thematic names (ARKK) while fixed income signals remain neutral-to-cautious (TLT BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +9.51%) — commodity and energy momentum. BEARISH: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -6.18%) — tech weakness to monitor.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +16.85%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +19.25%). BEARISH: SLV RECOVERY (1W: +3.28% | 1M: -8.47%) — silver remains in a short-term recovery within a weaker monthly trend.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (VXX RECOVERY 1W: +3.36% | 1M: -4.31%) as complacency threshold; HYG/LQD health watch with HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -0.06%) and LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -1.60%); XLK/XLF pivot level to watch for clear style rotation (XLK BELOW TREND | XLF CORRECTION).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, commodities and energy showing leadership while major growth names lag. Key divergence: CORRECTION in SPY (1W: -0.98% | 1M: +0.41%) and BELOW TREND QQQ (1W: -1.73% | 1M: -4.42%) vs ABOVE TREND XLE (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +9.51%) — monitor rotation into cyclicals and short-term volatility signals (VXX RECOVERY).
